run_gmock_gen: run gmock_gen.py on a C++ header file to generate Google Mock classes to stdout
generate_mock_classes: generate Google Mock classes for specified C++ classes from a header file using gmock_class.py
render_cpp_type: render a recursively templated C++ type with modifiers, pointers, and references into a string
generate_mock_methods: generate mocked virtual method declarations for a C++ class using EXPECT_CALL macros
parse_cpp_header: parse a C++ header file into an AST and filter for class definitions to generate mocks
